summary: One record per lab test per time point per visit per subject. Results often arrive from a vendor: keep their values in LBORRES and convert to standard units in LBSTRESC/N/U.

LBORRES.tip: As received from the lab, including text such as "<0.5".

LBSTRESN.tip: Numeric standardised value; empty for results like "<0.5" (keep those in LBSTRESC).

LBSTRESU.tip: One standard unit per test, usually SI or conventional as your sponsor decides, e.g. "U/L", "umol/L", "g/L".

LBLOBXFL.tip: "Y" on each subject's last non-missing result per test before first dose.

LBTOXGR.tip: CTCAE grade if your protocol grades lab toxicity.
